title: New Amazon Kinesis Clickpipe
summary: Ingest data from Amazon Kinesis in incredibly fast times with our new ClickPipe. ClickPipes provide a powerful yet simple, way of ingesting your continuous data in ClickHouse Cloud.

title: Query Insights UI
summary: Gain better insights into how your queries are performing with this sleek and elegant UI now available in ClickHouse Cloud. Using the Query Insights UI, you can now identify slow running and troublesome queries.

title: Export to Prometheus
summary: Seamless integration of ClickHouse Cloud metrics with Prometheus for monitoring and alerting. Gain extra insights into the performance, resource utilization, and health of your ClickHouse Cloud service.

title: Customizable controls for Backups
summary: Introducing new advanced controls for your Backups in ClickHouse Cloud. Now you can control the the precise time and frequency that backups are taken, as well as how long they are retained for.
imgAlt: Customizable backup controls for ClickHouse Cloud

title: Share query API endpoints
summary: Easily share API endpoints for any of your queries. Read-Only and Read-Write roles allow you to manage permissions effortlessly.
